title: 238 - Archon
method: claude-code: written from the transcript, links verified by script

items.name: Archon: The Light and the Dark
items.description: The episode's game: a chess-like strategy game where pieces fight real-time arena battles, ported to the NES in 1989.

links.label: Wikipedia: Archon: The Light and the Dark
Archon: The Light and the Dark - MobyGames
Archon: The Light and the Dark - StrategyWiki

items.name: Chess
items.description: The classic board game Archon resembles but differs from, with only one way to win.

links.label: Wikipedia: Chess
links.note: Traditional board game for two players

items.name: Othello
items.description: A recent tabletop-game adaptation on the NES, mentioned as the previous board-game-style episode.

items.name: Checkers
items.description: Another traditional tabletop game the NES might have received instead of an original like Archon.

items.name: Quidditch
items.description: The Harry Potter sport, where catching the snitch ends the game, compared to Archon's five power points.

items.name: XCOM
items.description: Turn-based tactics series mentioned as a game Archon is not like.

items.name: Endless Legend
items.description: A grid-based strategy game with battles inside the grid, offered as a closer comparison to Archon.

items.name: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
items.description: Its life-size wizard's chess match, where pieces fight, was compared to Archon's combat.

links.label: Wikipedia: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (film)

items.name: J. K. Rowling
items.description: Author of Harry Potter, joked about as the one to confirm how wizard's chess works.

items.name: Compute!'s Gazette
items.description: Magazine where the developers said the computer opponent plays worse over time in the computer versions.

links.label: Wikipedia: Compute!'s Gazette
links.note: U.S. magazine covering Commodore and retro computing

items.name: Electronic Arts
items.description: Publisher of the original Archon, one of its first five games.

items.name: Archon II: Adept
items.description: The 1984 sequel that adds magic points and resource management; computer only.

items.name: Amiga
items.description: One of the many computers Archon was released on.

items.name: Commodore 64
items.description: Home computer that also received Archon.

items.name: Apple II
items.description: Home computer that also received Archon.

items.name: ZX Spectrum
items.description: British home computer that also received Archon.

items.name: Amstrad CPC
items.description: British home computer joked about as rarely owned in America.

items.name: Atari 8-bit computers
items.description: The Atari 800 line, another computer that got Archon.

items.name: Intellivision Amico
items.description: Console that announced an updated Archon, joked about as never arriving.

items.description: The show's list of NES games that define the system; Archon was voted in.

items.name: Faxanadu
items.description: The previous Essential Games List addition, episode 207.
